sections.label: What
sections.html:
What we do

We prepare you for one exam, properly.

Not general English lessons with an exam bolted on. Every hour you spend with Bloom is aimed at a specific part of a specific paper, chosen because your own test results say that is where your marks are going.

IELTS Academic & General

Our core programme. Four skills, all question types, and the band descriptors read literally rather than paraphrased.

  • Academic for university admission
  • General Training for migration and work
  • Full 15-part curriculum by exam section

TOEFL, PTE & Duolingo

The same skills, different formats and different scoring. We teach the format explicitly, because that is where most points are lost.

  • TOEFL iBT — 0 to 120
  • PTE Academic — computer-scored
  • Duolingo English Test — adaptive

General & spoken English

For students who need confident English for work, study or daily life rather than a certificate with a number on it.

  • CEFR A1 to C2 progression
  • Workplace and interview English
  • Pronunciation by first language

One-to-one tutoring

Forty-five minutes with the teacher who specialises in the part you are stuck on. Same-day slots are usually available.

  • Examiner-led speaking mocks
  • Line-by-line essay review
  • Video, chat or send work ahead

Mock exams & marking

Full sittings under real timing, marked against the official descriptors, with a score report you could hand to a university.

  • Ten papers, full and by section
  • Score conversions to every scale
  • Ranked list of what to fix next

OET & medical English

The Occupational English Test for doctors, nurses, dentists, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals — delivered with Future MedsAcademy.

  • All twelve OET professions
  • Clinical role-plays with medics
  • GMC, NMC and AHPRA accepted

Applications & entries

We book your test, check your documents and tell you honestly whether you are ready to sit it yet.

  • Test-centre booking support
  • Readiness assessment before entry
  • University requirement guidance

Where Bloom came from

Founded in 2025, in three countries at once.

Bloom began as three separate teaching practices — one in Muscat, one in Milan and one in Shanghai — run by examiners who kept meeting the same problem: students who understood English but could not show it under exam conditions.

In 2025 the three merged and moved their operations to Bengaluru, India, where the academy is now headquartered. The teaching still runs out of all four locations, which is why there is almost always a live class in your evening.

sections.label: How
sections.html:
How we do it

Five stages. Nothing is guessed.

Most preparation fails for one reason: students practise without ever checking what they got wrong. Bloom is built to make that impossible.

Placement test

Twenty-five minutes across grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, writing and speaking. It returns a CEFR level, a band per skill, and your strongest and weakest areas — from what you actually did, not from what you told us.

Your English profile

An honest picture: where you sit on the CEFR scale, what your estimated band is on every exam scale, and which first-language errors we will be watching for as a speaker of your language.

A plan built from it

A day-by-day schedule to your test date, weighted towards your weakest skill, with a mock every Saturday and a checkpoint every fortnight. Tick each block off as you do it.

Practice with real feedback

Write an essay, get a band against all four descriptors and every error explained. Record a cue card, get fluency, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation scored separately. Your recurring mistakes are collected into an error bank.

Measured, then adjusted

Every scored activity moves your estimate. When a mock says your reading is the problem, next week's plan changes. You always know what to revise today and what you have already mastered.

The difference

Feedback is the whole product.

Anyone can sell you practice papers. Half a band takes roughly a hundred focused hours — and those hours only count if something tells you, precisely, what went wrong.

  • Every essay marked against the four official criteriaTask Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy — separately, with a band each.
  • Sentence-level corrections, not a gradeThe wrong version, the right version, and why. Repeat offenders go into your personal error bank.
  • Errors targeted to your first languageArticles for Hindi and Urdu speakers, plural and tense endings for Mandarin speakers, final consonants for Vietnamese speakers.
  • Spaced repetition that decides for you570 academic words scheduled so the ones you miss come back tomorrow and the ones you know disappear for a month.

People are becoming increasingly dependent on technology.

sections.label: Features
sections.html:
The platform

Everything a serious candidate needs, in one place.

Your school, your practice, your feedback and your teacher — organised by the part of the exam each thing belongs to.

The School

Class notes, printable PDFs, audio drills and video lectures — all filed under Listening Part 4, Writing Task 1 and the thirteen other parts of the exam.

Writing Lab

Write under exam timing, get a band per criterion, sentence-level corrections, a model answer and a persistent error bank.

Speaking Lab

Parts 1, 2 and 3 with a real preparation timer, recording, and analysis of fluency, filler words, idiomatic range and grammar.

Vocabulary engine

570 band-tagged words across nine essay topics, with six study modes and spaced repetition that schedules itself.

Grammar Academy

Twelve lessons — concept, real IELTS examples, then a test — ordered so the errors most common for your first language come first.

Bloom Tutor

Knows your level, your target, your weakest skill and every error pattern in your writing — so its advice is specific, never generic.

sections.label: Overseas
sections.html:
Study abroad · in partnership with FMA Overseas

A band is not the goal. The offer letter is.

Getting Band 7 is half the journey. Turning it into a place at a university abroad — the application, the credential check, the visa, the accommodation — is the other half. That is what FMA Overseas does, and Bloom students go straight through to them.

BloomIELTS Academy
FMA
FMA OverseasFuture MedsAcademy
Your Bloom score report transfers directly into an FMA Overseas application file. One team, one set of documents, no repeating yourself.
1

Reach your band

Bloom gets you to the score your target university requires — including any per-skill minimum, which is where most applications actually fail.

2

Shortlist with FMA

An FMA Overseas counsellor matches your band, transcript and budget against real entry requirements and tells you where you will get in.

3

Apply and get offers

Applications, statements of purpose, credential evaluation and reference chasing, handled for you. Multiple offers, not one hopeful punt.

4

Visa and finance

Student visa filing, financial documentation, tuition deposits and the interview preparation that decides a UKVI or SEVIS outcome.

5

Arrive settled

Accommodation, airport pickup, bank account, registration and a Bloom alumni contact already studying on your campus.

What the partnership covers

Everything between your result and your first lecture.

  • Requirement checking before you sitWe confirm the exact overall and per-skill minimum your shortlist demands, so you do not pass the test and still miss the offer.
  • Credential evaluationDegree and transcript assessment for the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, Germany and Italy — including ECTS conversion.
  • Pathway and foundation routesIf your band is not there yet, a pre-sessional English or foundation route that still leads to the same degree.
  • Scholarship and funding searchMerit awards, regional bursaries and assistantships matched to your profile — most students never find these alone.
  • Visa filing and interview prepFinancial evidence, the credibility interview, and the English-language part of the visa rules that changes most often.
  • One file, both teamsYour Bloom band history, mock reports and score conversions attach to your FMA application automatically.
